poses.name: ready
poses.intent: = attack_swing f1 = idle f1 exactly (CTRL / PROPS copied from idle.json poses[frame 1]): ready stance, club upright beside the right hip, free arm hanging.

poses.name: sag
poses.intent: Sag (reference f10-22, strength leaving; T101b): COG down 10 mm below ready (CTRL_torso loc Y -0.025) and 35 mm back (loc Z -0.035) so the planted legs stay straighter (knee 56; the 20 mm drop with the hips over the feet gave knee 65-71 and visible calf/thigh creases); whole body leans back from the hips (torso X -12) while the spine sags forward (spine_01 / chest X 14 each) and slightly to the character's right (Z 1 each, lean from the spine instead of the torso so the right knee does not bend past the left); head tipped back -10 (eye point about 52 mm lower than f1); left arm hanging slightly lower (upper arm Z -43.5 -> -45, elbow 35; -48 opened a visible armpit crease). Right arm / club = f1 values (right shoulder lowered by 4 deg opened a visible armpit crease). Feet planted.

poses.name: tip
poses.intent: Tip (reference f23-27, balance lost backward; T101c per user D1.3): sinking and sitting back - COG 3 mm below ready and 80 mm back (CTRL_torso loc Y -0.018, Z -0.08; knees 54.5/57.3 bent, hip flex negative = hips behind the feet; a 10-25 mm deeper sink bent the knees to 64-81 and opened visible calf/thigh and calf/pelvis creases 14-30 pairs), torso rotated back 32 deg at the hips, slight back arch (spine_01 / chest X -4) leaning to the character's right (Z 2 each), head tipped back -25; arms still low: left arm hanging slightly out (f1 values, upper arm Z -43.5 -> -42), right arm / club = f1 values; toes lifting on the heels (foot_roll -10 both). Contact none (reference feet start to lift at f27).

poses.name: impact
poses.intent: Impact (reference f31): lying on the back. COG rotated 90 deg back and lifted 26 mm above rest (CTRL_torso X -90, loc Y +0.026, 60 mm back; clip sweep_overrides) so the back / belt rests on the ground (lowest belt vertex about -1 mm); head tipped back -15 toward the ground (about 11 mm above); legs extended toward the camera and slightly up (foot IK loc Y 0.10, Z 0.21, rot X 80 so the soles face the camera; ik_ratio about 0.90); arms bent and resting on the ground close to the body sides like the reference: shoulders pulled back toward the ground (CTRL_shoulder X -18 / -19), upper arms back -40, lowered (Z -55 / +45) and twisted (Y +40 / -30) so the elbows bend 60 deg with the fists beside the chest; lowering the left upper arm to -55 without the twist or bending the elbow to 70 opened visible armpit / elbow creases. Club still in the right hand (weapon_space 0) laid flat on the ground along the right side toward the head with the weapon socket offset CTRL_weapon rot (90, 35, -6) (rotation about the grip inside the ball fist) and hand X 4. Front silhouette x about 107-773 px (896-px render).

poses.name: rest
poses.intent: Rest (reference f38, settled lying pose kept to f56): same body and arms as f31 (back on the ground, hands and club on the ground), head settled -17 (about 2 mm above the ground); legs slightly spread and lower (foot IK loc X -0.05 / +0.05, Y 0.08, Z 0.17; soles to the camera). arms bent and resting on the ground close to the body sides like the reference: shoulders pulled back toward the ground (CTRL_shoulder X -18 / -19), upper arms back -40, lowered (Z -55 / +45) and twisted (Y +40 / -30) so the elbows bend 60 deg with the fists beside the chest; lowering the left upper arm to -55 without the twist or bending the elbow to 70 opened visible armpit / elbow creases. Club still in the right hand (weapon_space 0) laid flat on the ground along the right side toward the head with the weapon socket offset CTRL_weapon rot (90, 35, -6) (rotation about the grip inside the ball fist) and hand X 4.
